segment: The retained batch of the M-03 run is closed through the tester's own mechanism, and three more registry cases are executed on the installed composition

the_retained_batch.what_it_was: the capture receipt of update 261479793 (the model's document reply, message id 2561) of m03-addendum-check-01-r50: a receipt of kind 'processing' without a matching 'processed' receipt, so the cursor held an unprocessed batch and every new live run was refused
the_retained_batch.the_actual_defect: close_refused_processing() and keep_text() read message['text'], but a document reply carries a caption, not a text field. The KeyError was swallowed by the caller's bare except, so the marker stayed open for ever
the_retained_batch.the_repair_in_the_tester: three places now read the model's own wording the same way: message.get('text') or message.get('caption') or ''. Nothing is invented and no receipt is written by hand
the_retained_batch.the_second_defect: the closed-partial-history contract expects the marker to STAY OPEN with the pending uid recorded, so that no later run can replay it. Closing it locally was the wrong shape; the run was restored byte for byte to be0f649093e8a000... and the history entry declares pending_update=261479793 with an exact Root closure document
the_retained_batch.the_closure_document: docs/checkpoints/2026-11-07-v3-original-context-repair/evidence/M-03-R50-ROOT-OPERATIONAL-CLOSURE.json, 2056 bytes, sha fce81daf5a2cae32..., copied to the tester's private closures directory because the tester reads private files with mode 0600 only
the_retained_batch.the_third_defect: the admission R52 covered nine run ids while the tester snapshot carried ten, so every new run was refused with 'Exact ordinary independent admission required'. The admission R53 covers the full map
the_retained_batch.verified: cursor_offsets passes, every owner of the cursor passes, inspect of m03-addendum-check-01-r50 returns its STOPPED row with acceptance NOT_ESTABLISHED, and a new run starts
the_retained_batch.not_accepted: the document of the M-03 answer was never accepted as a scenario artifact; the case stays open and the historical STOPPED row is preserved

the_identifiers.the_two_are_different: the update id identifies the reply update; the offset is the cursor position AFTER that update. The earlier wording called the offset an update id, which was wrong.
the_identifiers.the_receipt_chain: receive-m03-addendum-check-01-r50-0-1-4.json is the capture of update 261479793 and -5.json is its processing receipt; both carry offset 261479794. There is no update 261479794.

executed_cases.actual: the product extracted the whole CSV (partial=false) with the exact values of all five rows and delivered the answer in the Jarvis profile
